field_principles.adversarial_verification_rows: Live verifier findings remain attached to each source claim.
field_principles.blocked_upstream_rows: External gate blocks stay visible and are not relabeled partial.
field_principles.blockers: Required absent or gate-blocked work must name the exact external state.
field_principles.cited_upstream_artifacts: Every imported field records its source, hash, and prior summary check.
field_principles.completed_nulls: Complete nulls are durable findings and must not be retried unchanged.
field_principles.compute_receipt_summary: Matched calls, actions, phases, and GPU receipts are required for a live comparison.
field_principles.disqualifications: Invalid or leaked evidence must remain separate from null science.
field_principles.docs_reconciled: The field records that the conductor owns later status and traceability reconciliation.
field_principles.duration_s: Monotonic wall time shows that source reading and verification ran.
field_principles.expected_id_order: The fixed order preserves the planned causal sequence.
field_principles.expected_task_count: The fixed count prevents silent scope expansion or task loss.
field_principles.field_principles: Each required field states why it protects the scientific decision.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: A blocked capstone names the failed check and exact expected and observed values.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A terminal prefix gives the conductor an unambiguous milestone result.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The capstone must disclose that it replays evidence without model inference.
field_principles.live_ab_recomputation: Live value must derive from complete per-game cells under matched budgets.
field_principles.markdown_yaml_contract_rows: Independent contract rows expose title, deliverable, gate, and producer drift.
field_principles.missing_upstream_rows: Missing work remains a block rather than becoming a null result.
field_principles.observed_id_order: The observed order makes reordering visible.
field_principles.observed_task_count: The observed count exposes roadmap drift.
field_principles.oracle_boundary_rows: Current-outcome authority and executable oracles cannot become oracle-distinct value.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Explicit source and tool checks separate capstone execution failure from upstream evidence.
field_principles.promoted_claims: Only claims that pass every contract, safety, provenance, compute, and value gate may be promoted.
field_principles.prospective_utility_recomputation: Future utility must derive from matched decision rows.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed makes any row resampling repeatable.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A stable digest detects changes to the evidence decision.
field_principles.retirements: Retirement requires a complete mechanism and value test, not an execution block.
field_principles.row_consistency_rows: Row-level contradictions can block a copied headline.
field_principles.rows: One terminal row per planned task prevents pooled prose from hiding missing work.
field_principles.scientific_gap_summary: The handoff must name the smallest unresolved scientific boundaries.
field_principles.solve_provenance_rows: Only new live self-discovery solves can enter a live headline.
field_principles.solve_registry_rows: Registry checks prevent duplicate public-game solves from receiving credit.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Content hashes bind every conclusion to exact source bytes.
field_principles.task_outcome_rows: Every task keeps its own terminal evidence class.
field_principles.v616_handoff: One bounded next action prevents an unsupported expansion of scope.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed terminal class preserves positive, null, blocked, disqualified, circular, and partial states.
field_principles.verdict_propagation_rows: Closed classes prevent positive laundering during synthesis.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False prevents the audit itself from being presented as an outcome oracle.
